title: Brain Pack Schema
description: A pack is a domain bundle installed on a brain: a list of brain-apps (installed through the normal GitHub-URL path), tool ids to enable, governance .md files to install, and an optional compute spoke declaration. Files live at brain-apps/packs/<name>.json in the brainfoundry-nous template. The base pack is what every instance ships with; other packs (music, video) require it. Added 2026-09-13 (unreleased 0.10.0).

name.description: Pack id. Must equal the file name without .json (brain-apps/packs/<name>.json).

version.description: Semver of the pack definition itself. Each pack is versioned independently of the OS.

requires.description: Other packs that must be installed first. The seeder installs them in dependency order; a missing requirement fails the pack, not the brain.

apps.description: Brain-apps in this pack. Same shape as the old defaults.json entries: id is the manifest id (used for the install-if-absent precheck); the authoritative id, route and version come from the repo's brain-app.yaml at install time.

ref.description: Branch, tag, or commit SHA. Pin a tag for anything a buyer receives.

tools.description: Tool ids from api/tools/ this pack enables. Declared only in this version; enabling is a later step.

path.description: Path inside the template repo of a governance .md this pack installs (e.g. a verb catalogue).

md.description: Governance .md files the pack brings. Declared only in this version.

compute.description: Optional spoke declaration for the whole pack: a separate host owned by the same person that runs the pack's heavy jobs. Same shape as the compute block in brain-app.schema.json. null when the pack needs no spoke.
